headline: '3 Homes vs. 1 Home' Comprehensive Real Estate Tax Gap Widens… Non-Resident Reduction Begins at Market Value of 13.4 Billion Won
summary: From 2028, the imbalance in comprehensive real estate tax based on the number of homes will generally grow larger, drawing controversy over tax fairness. Reduction for non-residents begins at a market value of 13.4 billion won.
why: Property taxes shape housing demand, holding costs and household wealth, which matter for real estate and banking exposure.
